clips.title: The story
paras: A keg bearing Chen Stormstout’s mark lies abandoned in the Barrens. Its discovery points toward the wandering brewmaster’s old ties to Durotar.

Travelers sometimes find an abandoned wooden barrel across the dry Barrens. Razormane quilboar and Kolkar centaur leave ordinary casks behind, but this barrel is carefully made and bears a plaque: “Chen Stormstout - May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits.” It is an odd relic beneath Kalimdor’s sun. To learn how it came to the Barrens, you seek someone who knows brewing.

Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet recognizes the keg’s craftsmanship and names Chen Stormstout as its owner. Chen, a wandering Pandaren, traveled with Rexxar during the battles that secured Durotar for Thrall’s Horde. Years have passed since Chen walked Kalimdor’s red earth, yet seasoned brewers still remember his recipes and wandering spirit.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,
May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."

clips.title: Completion
paras: This was one of Chen Stormstout's kegs. He traveled with Rexxar a long time ago. I haven't seen or heard about him in a kodo's age. I appreciate you bringing this to me, friend.
